label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: BMW Championship Outlook
items.text: Rory McIlroy is positioned to chase Wyndham Clark in the Sunday final round of the BMW Championship, aiming to achieve a feat not seen since 1997 at Bellerive Country Club.

items.headline: Mini Driver Trend
items.text: Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy are leading a surge among the top 50 PGA Tour players switching from traditional drivers to mini drivers in 2026.

items.headline: LIV Golf Indianapolis Leader
items.text: NCAA leader Michael La Sasso holds a 13-under lead going into the final round at LIV Golf Indianapolis, one stroke ahead of four contenders seeking their first LIV victory.
